cases.name: a-running-total-that-does-not-say-what-to-add-up
cases.description: A running total reads another column and draws nothing of its own, so of= is not optional.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Op"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="running" accumulate="sum"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{B}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-running-total-reading-a-column-declared-below-it
cases.description: The total is built in declaration order out of a column that already exists — the same rule parent= follows, and for the same reason.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="B"><gen type="running" of="Op" accumulate="sum"/></sequence><sequence name="Op"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{B}}</data></line></block></tdc>
